# Inder Psychotherapy Services — Amrinderjit Singh, LCSW

> Forensic immigration mental health evaluations by Amrinderjit (Inder) Singh, a Licensed Clinical Social Worker licensed in New York, New Jersey, California, Washington, Michigan, Wisconsin, Indiana, Pennsylvania, and Virginia. Evaluations are conducted by secure telehealth in English, Punjabi, and Hindi (no interpreter); Urdu and Spanish via interpreter. Based at 115-13 Jamaica Ave, Richmond Hill, NY 11418. Phone/text (516) 366-0247. Email Support@InderTherapy.com.

Key facts:
- Evaluation types: VAWA (I-360, battered spouse waiver), asylum/withholding/CAT, U-Visa (I-918, I-192), T-Visa (I-914), extreme hardship waivers (I-601, I-601A, 212(h)), cancellation of removal (EOIR-42A/42B).
- Does NOT complete Form N-648 (USCIS accepts it only from MDs, DOs, and clinical psychologists).
- Every evaluation is conducted and written personally by Amrinderjit Singh, LCSW. 500+ evaluations completed.
- Standard turnaround 10–15 business days; 7-business-day expedited available. Same-business-day response to attorneys.
- Clients must be physically located in one of the nine licensed states during the telehealth session.
